issues.title: Three C bodies in src/ that do not match: one extra nop after mfc1
issues.author: ReaperOfVeriod
issues.body:
Maintainer resolution — 21 October 2026
Resolved on the qualified current toolchain. The four reported functions pass all placements: func_00290680 28/28 (148 bytes), func_002ED4B8 28/28 (176 bytes), func_L22_003A2DF8 2/2 (20 bytes), and its caller func_L22_003A2D58 2/2 (156 bytes). The reviewed integration including merged #256 passes python3 tools/build.py all --strict --jobs 8: all 28 programs OK, with no C fallback.

issues.title: 128-bit matching: qualified zero-store and vector-copy compiler profiles
issues.author: ReaperOfVeriod
issues.body:
Maintainer status — 21 October 2026
Both compiler mechanisms in this issue now have qualified implementations.
PR #262 adds the default-off, per-file -frac2-qcopy profile. An ordinary aligned
TImode C assignment can now keep both addresses in registers and use a grouped
lq/sq pair with its temporary register declared to the compiler. It preserves
memory flags and alias sets, rejects explicitly unaligned accesses, and adds no
memory barrier or source-level assembly. -fno-rac2-qcopy restores the…
